title: Filter, Map and Reduce
introduction: Common collection transformations communicate intent more directly than one large loop.
learningOutcomes: Recognise side effects that make a pipeline harder to reason about.

activities.question: Which operation keeps only values that satisfy a condition?
activities.explanation: Filtering selects a subset without changing the selected values.

activities.question: Turning every price into a price including tax is a ___ operation.
activities.explanation: Mapping transforms each input item into a corresponding output item.

activities.question: A reduce operation can combine a collection into one total.
activities.explanation: Reduce, fold or aggregate operations update an accumulator across the collection.
